name: ada-audit-scripts
description: Read-only accessibility audit helpers (WCAG 2.2 AA candidates) built on Playwright, axe-core and the Guidepup Virtual Screen Reader. Not a compliance certification.

scripts.smoke: node inventory.mjs --urls examples/urls.txt --out ./audit-output && node axe-scan.mjs --urls examples/urls.txt --widths 390 --out ./audit-output && node context-change.mjs --urls examples/urls.txt --out ./audit-output && node sample-compare.mjs --urls examples/urls.txt --out ./audit-output
